units.source_text: 啊，祖父不是也意识到“某些东西”了吗？

en.t: Ah, had Grandfather not also sensed that "something"?
Was that not a kind of premonition?

units.source_text: （我担心祖父让我给他平素很少通信的妹妹寄明信片，请她前来，

en.t: (I was troubled by the fact that Grandfather had asked me to send a postcard to his younger sister, with whom he rarely corresponded, asking her to come,

units.source_text: 这会不会是祖父预感到自己快要死了呢？）

en.t: and wondered whether this meant Grandfather had a premonition that he was about to die.)

units.source_text: 我盯着祖父苍白的脸，直到自己的眼睛模糊了。

en.t: I stared at Grandfather's pale face until my own eyes grew blurred.
